decisions.reason: The candle arch is a core Erzgebirge craft form, and adding light and sound builds on its existing woodworking and assembly know-how, so the firm can read early results and refine the line.
A one-tier arched pyramid sits squarely within the firm's carving and turning expertise, making it low-risk and easy to keep improving.

The electronic music box with interchangeable discs is the declared flagship, and although electronics stretch the firm's knowledge base, it pairs this with familiar woodwork and will likely give the line time to learn.
As an accessory platform tied to the flagship music box, it relies on the firm's existing figure and platform craftsmanship, though its minor website presence makes it a candidate for range pruning.
The Christmas motif platform draws on the firm's core seasonal figure-making and supports the music box system, but it is only mentioned on the website, which leaves some risk of being pruned.
A themed Christmas pyramid fits the firm's traditional strength, and regional themes such as Dresden typically sell steadily to collectors.
